description: Explains why a collection cannot be read or written with the current token: whether it exists, whether it is active, whether the token holds item, field and relation permissions, and which of those is the blocker. Read-only and safe against production. Reach for it first when a tool returns an empty result or a forbidden error, before concluding the data is missing; validate_collection_schema covers a suspect schema and refresh_collection_cache a collection that was just created. Each include flag adds targeted probe requests against Directus.
name: diagnose_collection_access
